tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Financial Part of the tender shall be submitted as on Online. Financial tender shall contain only Financials quoted by the Tenderer. The bid winner shall be the bidder who offers the lowest Service Charges, however quoted Service Charges shall not be less than 3.85% else such a bid shall be rejected and EMD shall be forfeited. Applicable income tax and other statutory deductions will be deducted as per prevailing rules against the bills submitted. Professional tax will be deducted as per PT rules.

If two or more numbers of the bidders are found to be L1 then, the highest Score in the Technical Evaluation will be considered as L1. If this also fulfilled by the bidders, then the bidder having the highest turnover will be selected among the two or more by Committee.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Should have satisfactorily completed at least one similar nature of work of Supply of Junior Health Inspectors / Solid Waste Inspectors /Any Diploma/Graduate Engineers of Amount Rs. 79.00 Lakhs in any one of the last 5 financial years. i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26. (Relevant Experience certificate and single Work Orders need to be enclosed)
